thread:
olivia: FYI — during the A/B tiered-surge experiment this morning a handful of customers got an unexpected "surge surcharge" line twice on their draft invoices. I spotted it in the canary cohort (acct ids: 9972, 9981, 9990). Can we triage? :eyes:

aj: Ack. I'm on billing-engine logs now. Initial theory: rounding + &apply_surcharge path executed twice for some batch jobs. Pulling logs for job windows 08:00-08:10 UTC.

samir: Do we have rollout flags tied to the surcharge? I thought the A group had the new surcharge, B didn't. If duplicates are only in A, that's expected distribution-wise but not the double-charge.

olivia: Right — A is supposed to get the 0.5% surge multiplier on top of usage. But the duplicate line is definitely a bug; it's creating a second line with identical label. Customers will see a higher total. We should prepare a credit plan and a communication draft.

aj: Quick query I ran:
```
SELECT invoice_id, COUNT(*) as lines, SUM(amount) as total
FROM invoice_lines
WHERE label LIKE '%surge%'
AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-18 08:00:00' AND '2026-03-18 08:15:00'
GROUP BY invoice_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
```
Returned 6 invoice_ids. Looks like a race in the batch retry logic — same batch processed twice because the upstream job ack didn't persist before retry.

marie: If it's a retry bug, we should target a hotfix to the retry/ack path first. Also we need a grandfathering decision for customers who were in the old pricing tier but part of the experiment — do we keep their legacy credit rules? We promised to preserve credits for legacy customers last quarter.

david: For immediate mitigation: 1) pause the A rollout flag to stop new surcharges, 2) add a dedupe guard in the invoice pipeline for labels with identical metadata within a 1-minute window, and 3) schedule a job to compute credits for affected invoices. Approving 1 and 2 now.

samir: Agreed on pause. Who has permission to flip the rollout flag? @aj?

aj: I can flip it now. Done — flag `tiered_surge_v2` paused at 08:22 UTC. Added temporary alert on duplicate surge lines.

olivia: Thank you. Next — credits: recommended approach = issue reversing line + positive credit note so accounting ties back. We should avoid editing invoices in place to keep audit trail.

marie: Sounds good. What's the estimated credit amount? We need to notify revenue ops for MRR impact.

aj: Preliminary sum of duplicate lines = $4,312 across the 6 invoices (net). I'll run a reconciliation job to produce a per-account credit file (CSV).

billing-bot: Deploy bot: billing-service v3.14.2 rolled back to v3.14.1 at 08:25 UTC based on alert: invoice-duplicates-detected.

samir: Rollback noted. For the experiment design: can we keep the A/B buckets but ensure retries are idempotent? If we need to re-run the A cohort after patch, we must decide if those 6 accounts are excluded (so they don't get re-surcharged).

david: Exclude the affected invoice IDs/accnts from any automated rerun. We'll re-run the experiment on a fresh canary slice later. Also approve issuing one-off credits. Finance sign-off? @marie

marie: Approve issuing credits for the duplicate lines for impacted invoices. Please include a note: "credit issued due to system duplication during tiered-surge experiment." Also capture an approval record in the billing ops ticket.

olivia: I'll draft a short customer note for the affected accounts and the internal comms for sales/CS. Quick draft: "We've identified a duplicate surcharge that was applied to a small number of draft invoices during today's pricing experiment. We've applied a credit to correct the discrepancy and apologize for the inconvenience. No action required on your part." Comments?

samir: Add a line: "If you have questions, contact billing@redwood.ai" and mention timeframe for credit posting (within 3 business days).

olivia: Done.

aj: Action items summary:
- [aj] Hotfix dedupe guard + rollback verification (in progress)
- [aj] Produce credits CSV by 09:15 UTC
- [david] Exclude affected accounts from rerun
- [marie] Approve credits (done)
- [olivia] Customer + internal comms draft
- [samir] Add experiment exclusion rules for retry scenarios

I'll push the credit CSV to /mnt/billing/credits/2026-03-18/duplicate-surge-credits.csv when ready.

marie: Once credits are applied, please cc finance@redwood.ai for ledger posting.

olivia: Thanks team. Will follow up with a short postmortem once we have root cause and timeline for re-running the A cohort. :thumbsup:
